relationships.subject: ketamine
relationships.evidence_quote: In conclusion, results suggested that a single dose of ketamine can relieve fentanyl-induced-hyperalgesia via the TLR4/NF-κB pathway in spinal cord neurons.

relationships.subject: TAK-242
relationships.evidence_quote: Moreover, fentany-linduced-hyperalgesia and changes in the expression of the aforementioned proteins can be attenuated by TAK-242, an inhibitor of TLR4, as well as ketamine.

key_findings: Single-dose ketamine relieved fentanyl-induced hyperalgesia and reversed spinal TLR4, p-p65, COX-2, IL-1β and TNF-α expression.
TLR4, p-p65, COX-2 and IL-1β were expressed in spinal neurons but not glia.
